part.text:
Build confirms `/` is now `◐ Partial Prerender` — static shell + streamed holes. Changes:

- `app/page.tsx`: removed the top-level `await` that made the whole route dynamic; shell (heading + layout) now prerenders, each section streams independently behind its own `<Suspense>` with layout-matching skeleton fallbacks (no CLS), and `cache()` dedupes the shared fetch into one request with explicit `no-store`.
- Deleted `app/loading.tsx` — the full-page spinner is obsolete now that the shell renders instantly.
